policy.identical_duplicate_policy: identical duplicate rows are deduplicated and counted
policy.conflict_policy: any primary/secondary date disagreement in the decision window, or a positive-volume eligible stock date outside both indices, is a CONFLICT; operations depending on that window halt
policy.watermark_policy: LastPossibleDeven component agreement is an observation feeding an explicitly named assumed_completion; official completion stays unverified
policy.weekend_policy: Thursday/Friday absence is advisory only; sessions are never generated
policy.future_date_policy: dates after the Tehran-local reference day are rejected
policy.coverage_policy: each index must have a decision-day anchor (a row on/before window_start) and non-empty history; the union of two histories never substitutes per-source coverage

limitations: completeness_certified=false: both indices come from one provider and are not independent; agreement does not certify that every market session is present.
LastPossibleDeven component semantics are not officially documented; component agreement feeds an explicitly named assumed_completion, never an official confirmation.
Identity endpoint rows carry dEven=0; they are used for identity only, never for session dates.
This dataset is not an NSCStart equivalent; no NSCEnd field is fabricated.
No future sessions are predicted; Thursday/Friday patterns are advisory only and never generate sessions.
Days absent from all sources are NO_POSITIVE_EVIDENCE, never definite market closure.
Whether the identity endpoint enumerates non-TSE indices was not established.
Archive cross-check eligibility requires per-symbol traceable identity evidence; unproven symbols are skipped, never assumed same-market.
End of the usual market day clock time is not used as completion evidence.
